name: application-version-history-list
title: Version History List
description: Timestamped revision rows with author, a Current badge on the latest version, and View diff/Restore actions on prior versions.
useWhen: Showing a document, record, or file's edit history with who changed it and when.
Users need to compare a past revision against the current one, or roll back to it.
You want the current version visually distinct from restorable prior versions, not just another row in the list.
avoidWhen: You're showing product/release history rather than a single record's edits — use `changelog-entry` for that dated-release framing instead.
There's no diff or restore capability — a plain `activity-feed` entry is sufficient for read-only change logs.
Only one version ever exists — there's no history to list.
responsiveBehavior: Author info truncates in a flexible middle column while the trailing badge/actions stay a fixed width, keeping row height constant across revisions.
accessibility: The current version's status is conveyed by visible text ("Current"), not position or color alone.
View diff and Restore are separate, explicitly labeled buttons rather than a single ambiguous overflow action.
Author avatars are decorative (empty alt) since the name is present as adjacent text.
Restore is a destructive-leaning action (reverts current state) — pair with a confirmation step in your real implementation rather than firing on a single click.

variants.title: Version History List
variants.description: Four revisions: the current version with a badge, and three prior versions each with View diff and Restore actions.
accessibility: Whether a row shows the Current badge or the action pair is computed from a single isCurrent flag per revision.

variants.title: Version History List (Dark)
variants.description: Version history list adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Current badge and action link colors are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
